verdict.rationale: PagerDuty explicitly ships a 'Status Pages' feature described as giving 'visual, real-time insights into an organization's operations, and the status of incident resolution,' driven by incident state, letting teams 'proactively and securely communicate real-time operational updates' as a single source of truth — confirming the core hosted-status-page-driven-by-incidents capability. However, the evidence never mentions custom domain support or subscriber notification mechanisms (email/SMS subscriptions) for the status page. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of custom domain configuration, subscriber notification/opt-in flow, and any independent/hands-on confirmation these work as described.
